# eon_resource_backup_exclusion (Resource)

Excludes an inventory resource from future Eon backups and suppresses scanning and violations.

When this resource is created, the inventory resource is excluded from backup. When destroyed, the exclusion is cancelled and the resource is included in future backups.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    eon = {
      source = "eon-io/eon"
    }
  }
}

# Example: Exclude an inventory resource from future backups
resource "eon_resource_backup_exclusion" "demo" {
  resource_id = "1ee34dc5-0a7c-4e56-a820-917371e05c8d"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the inventory resource to exclude from backup.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the inventory resource. Mirrors `resource_id`.
